title: Zodiac Baracuda G3 Kit with Advanced Suction Side Automatic Pool Wall/Floor Cleaner and Additional Finned Disc
features: Quiet, powerful suction cleaner; works with low-speed pumps for maximum efficiency.
Devours small and medium-sized debris and cleans floor, walls and steps of your entire pool.
FlowKeeper Valve automatically regulates water flow to maintain peak cleaning performance even with lower horsepower pumps. Wheel Deflector for movement around tight corners.
Scuff-resistant Long-Life Hoses eliminate scuffs on all pool surfaces.
The G3 cleaner and additional finned disk will ship separately.
